# The Warthens (thewarthens.com)

> Juston and Atiya Warthen share Tech Journey (honest guides for a career change into tech) and Faith Journey (their faith story and a community for women). They also make Tech Journey Jr., a free game for kids.

## Tech Journey Jr. (for kids and parents)

- [Tech Journey Jr.](https://thewarthens.com/techjr): Free educational games for kids ages 5 to 10 that teach online safety, tech and creator careers, and cool facts. No ads, no sign-in, nothing a child picks is saved. Includes a kit for career day tables.
- [Play the game](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/play): Pick an age group. Tech Sprouts (ages 5 to 7, read-aloud voice, picture choices) or Tech Trailblazers (ages 8 to 10).
- [Internet safety for kids: 10 simple rules by age](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/internet-safety-for-kids)
- [Safe educational games for kids: a parent's checklist](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/how-to-choose-safe-educational-games)
- [What to do when your kid is bored: 20 screen-smart ideas](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/things-to-do-when-kids-are-bored)
- [Cool tech facts for kids](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/cool-tech-facts-for-kids)
- [Black inventors and tech heroes for kids](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/black-inventors-and-tech-heroes-for-kids)
- [Women in tech and STEM for kids](https://thewarthens.com/techjr/women-in-tech-and-stem-for-kids)

## Tech Journey (adults changing careers)

- [Tech Journey](https://thewarthens.com/tech): Career quiz, pay snapshots, resume checklist, and Start Here guides for tech sales, cybersecurity, coding, and data analytics.
- [1:1 coaching with Jermell Mitchell](https://thewarthens.com/tech/coaching): Career coaching with a free 15-minute intro call.

## Faith Journey

- [Faith Journey](https://thewarthens.com/faith): The Warthens' faith story and writings.
- [Women Who Seek](https://thewarthens.com/faith/women-who-seek): A community for women, hosted by Atiya.
- [Present but Missing: a Bible lesson for men](https://thewarthens.com/faith/present-but-missing): A free read-along lesson for men on being fully present, not only providing. Isaiah 58 and Matthew 23, four settings (personal pressure, home, church, community), reflection questions, Scripture, a next step for each, and an optional emailed PDF of your notes. Short link: thewarthens.com/present.

## Contact

- [Contact The Warthens](https://thewarthens.com/contact): Email info@thewarthens.com with questions about our videos, Tech Journey, Faith Journey, Tech Jr., or 1:1 coaching.
